transaction_controller_design.ARM: record intent, trigger observation digest, intended delta, and expiry; emit no rewrite
REVALIDATE: the exact baseline purchase slot still exists
the route has not already satisfied the animal target
cash reserve and order-slot capacity remain valid
pasture, shed, pickup/place workers, inventory, and horizon remain feasible
no conflicting baseline continuation owns the same slot
transaction_controller_design.COMMIT: rewrite only the validated order, then audit purchase, pickup, and placement atomically
transaction_controller_design.SAFE_CANCEL: clear intent, emit the byte-equivalent baseline action, record one reason code, and do not latch a per-turn fallback diagnostic

mediator_conclusion.scope: Deterministic one-step source-code mediation diagnostic for this pair; not a population-level effect estimate.
